title: Cruicetown, Nobber, Nobber, Co. Meath
description:
A large five-bedroom detached dormer bungalow set on a private site in the countryside at Cruicetown, close to Nobber.

Offered fully furnished, the home provides five bedrooms and four bathrooms, with a good mix of living and bedroom space across two floors. The size and layout make it a great fit for family life, with plenty of room for day-to-day living and guests.

Outside, the property sits on a large private site with a generous garden, detached garage and ample parking. Electric entrance gates add privacy and give the home a strong sense of separation from the road.

The property holds a B energy rating and benefits from oil fired central heating.

The location is another key strength. You get the space and privacy of a countryside setting while staying within easy reach of Nobber, with good access to Kingscourt, Kells and Navan. Schools, shops, sports clubs and day-to-day services are all within reach.

A strong rental option for a family looking for a furnished detached home with plenty of space inside and out.

Key Features

- Five bedrooms
- Four bathrooms
- Detached dormer bungalow
- Fully furnished
- B energy rating
- Large private garden
- Detached garage
- Electric entrance gates
- Oil fired central heating
- Ample parking
- Countryside setting
- Good access to Nobber, Kingscourt, Kells and Navan

To Apply

To apply or request full details, please email info@keenanauctioneers.com with landlord and employer references, photo ID, contact number, and details of intended occupants.

Please note that pets are not permitted under the terms of the tenancy.
